content: SQLite append-only enforcement: CREATE TRIGGER name BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE ON table BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'msg'); END; per sqlite.org/lang_createtrigger.html. RAISE(ABORT) aborts statement and rolls back its changes keeping prior uncommitted tx work. Enforcement is app-level not cryptographic: DROP TRIGGER can bypass. SQLite has no INSTEAD OF triggers on regular tables; BEFORE...RAISE(ABORT) is the equivalent.
